revision_summary: Two minor quote/timestamp precision issues to fix: (1) cherry_pick_moments[6] and script_coverage 'appointment_set' both cite ts 07:53 or slightly misattribute the 'We could do five or 07:30' line — the actual transcript timestamp for that phrase is 07:49, not 07:53; correct both timestamps. (2) Fix schema_reference in cherry_pick_moments[4] (07:09, conditional_booking) — protocols.time_constraint does not cover channel/format preference (phone/Zoom vs in-person); either cite this as an unaddressed schema gap or reference analysis_directives.conditional_booking_detection instead, and don't imply the schema has a directly-applicable protocol when it doesn't. (3) Correct the classification label on the 01:26 moment from 'spouse_handling' to something reflecting the correct adult-child context (the schema_reference itself, protocols.adult_child_decision_maker, is correct — just the label is mismatched, which could confuse a manager scanning for spouse-related coaching). (4) Add the 03:00 'I don't have it yet' moment to the multi_touch_patterns bill/email friction sequence — it's the actual onset of the friction (customer retrieving bill from her car) and extends the documented friction window from ~2:42 to a fuller ~3:00-6:38 span, strengthening the time-burn observation already made. (5) Consider flagging the 01:32 credit threshold phrasing ('above 6670') under schema_drift_detection per the existing qualifiers.drift_observed precedent (SESSION18_fcbf33c1 stated 650) — this is a directly analogous case the schema explicitly asks Stewart to watch for and Stage 3 missed it. None of these rise to fabrication-level severity or a wrong outcome read; the core trajectory, booking outcome, and coaching priorities (co-owner follow-through, missing legitimacy intro) are well-supported and should remain.
